text_block_list.text:
The "Summer Training Camp" starts today! 
The Umamusume head to the academy's 
special facility to begin their intensive 
training!
Of course, King Halo was no exception...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer. Burn this image deep into 
your eyes.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
The me before summer began, and the me now 
that it has ended. In just one single 
summer, King will show you a growth that 
borders on terrifying.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And someday, this dormitory will become 
one of the world's leading tourist spots 
as "the place where King Halo stayed."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, compared to the great deeds I'm about 
to accomplish, I'd say this is rather on 
the smaller side, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. Besides, there are still things I 
want to achieve in these dorms.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, one day, with my authority—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"—I'm going to make them install more air 
conditioners in this facility. 
Seriously... it's just too hot..."

Tucking those words quietly away in my 
heart, our training camp with King Halo 
had begun!
